name: joust_through_kills_an_attacker_and_gains_one_life
notes: Printed: 'Joust Through deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. You gain 1 life.' On seat 1's turn its 3/3 attacks; in the declare attackers step seat 0 casts Joust Through on the ATTACKING 3/3: it dies (to the graveyard: no exile clause) before damage, and seat 0 gains 1 life (20 -> 21) and takes no combat damage.
